items.title: User-specific records require identity and ownership checks
items.statement: Any feature exposing user-specific records should evaluate identity, ownership, privilege, tenant boundary, and auditability.
items.revalidation_trigger: Permission model, tenant model, or data classification changes.

items.title: Role boundary and audit blind spot
items.statement: When staff or support roles access customer records, ask who may access which records, why, with what audit trail, and what masking applies.
items.revalidation_trigger: Role policy or audit requirements change.
